project_identity.full_name: Sistem Terintegrasi Kemitraan Teknologi Industri Pertanian — Program Studi Teknologi Industri Pertanian, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Jember
project_identity.tagline: Single Source of Truth & Governance untuk Kemitraan Industri Agro modern dan Program Kampus Berdampak
project_identity.brand_archetype: Swiss Academic Precision meets Agritech Innovation

theme.description: Clean, authoritative academic ERP aesthetic using official Universitas Jember (UNEJ) Deep Blue & Golden Amber paired with fresh Agritech Emerald accents and subtle slate surfaces.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_strategy.mode: High Density Institutional Dashboard & Repository (Mode B Bento Grid)
layout_strategy.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar with UNEJ Deep Blue gradient overlay, role indicator pill, collapsible navigation links, active highlight in UNEJ Gold accent
layout_strategy.top_header: Sticky translucent glass header (`backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200`) featuring UNEJ official logo badge, full system name, search bar, notification center bell with unread badge, and user role switcher

login_page.student_flow: Magic-link email login with NIM verification, instant OTP simulation, student profile pre-fill
login_page.staff_flow: NIP / Email + Password auth with Role Selection (Admin, Tim Kerja Sama, Tim MBKM, Tim Manajemen)
login_page.branding_hero: Split visual screen showcasing UNEJ emblem, agricultural technology imagery, and key statistical highlights

kpi_cards: Dokumen PKS / IA / MoU Active (Expiring Soon Alert)
Cakupan Kampus Berdampak (Eligible vs Implemented Ratio)
charts: Tren Pertumbuhan Partner Industri (Recharts Area Chart)
Tren Implementasi Kegiatan per Semester (Recharts Bar Chart)
Coverage Radar & Keterlibatan Dosen/Mahasiswa (Recharts Radar/Bar Chart)

features: Single Source of Truth Partner Registry
Duplicate Partner Detection Engine (Alert Banner on duplicate NIB/Name)
Partner 360 Detail View (Profile, Address, Sector, Active MoUs/PKS, Contact Person, Audit History)
Filterable by Industry Sector, Region, Partnership Status, Active Documents
Version History Log (v1.0, v1.1, v2.0 with changelog & author NIP)
Status Badges: Draft, Active, Expired, Superseded
Document File Preview modal & Download button
Submit Output & Bukti Implementsasi (Link/File upload simulation)
Eligibility Checker Matrix (Kriteria IKU / MBKM / Riset Terapan)
Immutable Log Table with Timestamp, User ID, Role, Action Type, Entity Affected, IP Address
Exportable Log and Filter by Date Range / User Role
Slide-over panel for critical alerts (Document Expiry, Approval Requests, New Partner Added)
Mark as Read / Mark All as Read actions

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_usage: Page transitions with light fade and slide-up, tab switching smooth indicators, modal dialog scale-in, accordion transitions
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive table rows show subtle background tint (`hover:bg-slate-50/80`), buttons feature standard transform scaling (`active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150`), status badges highlight on hover
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` toast triggers for all CRUD actions (Saved, Updated, Deleted, Exported, Notification Dismissed)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: MUST add `data-testid` on all buttons, links, search inputs, dropdown triggers, document action items, table rows, and status badges using kebab-case role naming (e.g. data-testid='partner-table-row-1', data-testid='btn-export-pdf', data-testid='select-role-filter')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Text colors must maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio over white and slate backgrounds. Dark surfaces strictly use `#FFFFFF` or `#F8FAFC` high contrast text.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: Ring focus indicators on all inputs and interactive buttons using `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:outline-none`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always display the full unabbreviated institutional title 'Sistem Terintegrasi Kemitraan Teknologi Industri Pertanian — Program Studi Teknologi Industri Pertanian, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Jember' prominently in header or banner.
Follow the primary palette: UNEJ Blue (#0B2545) and UNEJ Yellow Gold (#F5A623 / #FFC72C) with Agritech Emerald accents.

Implement full mock data for all key modules: Master Partner Database, Document Repository with Versioning, Implementation Module (Dual Status), Kampus Berdampak, Audit Trail, Reports with export simulation, In-app Notifications, and Login (Magic Link + Password).
Ensure all interactive UI controls have appropriate `data-testid` attributes.
Use standard Lucide icons and Recharts for data visualizations.
Use Sonner for toast feedback across all interactions.
